scripts.typecheck: tsc -p apps/shell --noEmit && tsc -p apps/journey-ponto --noEmit && tsc -p apps/journey-beneficios --noEmit && tsc -p apps/journey-holerite --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.build:remotes: npm run build -w @portal/journey-ponto && npm run build -w @portal/journey-beneficios && npm run build -w @portal/journey-holerite
scripts.build: npm run build:remotes && npm run build -w @portal/shell
scripts.dev: concurrently -n bff,legado,ponto,benef,holer,shell -c blue,gray,green,magenta,yellow,cyan "npm run start -w @portal/bff" "npm run serve:legacy" "npm run dev -w @portal/journey-ponto" "npm run dev -w @portal/journey-beneficios" "npm run dev -w @portal/journey-holerite" "npm run dev -w @portal/shell"
scripts.preview: npm run build && concurrently -n bff,legado,ponto,benef,holer,shell -c blue,gray,green,magenta,yellow,cyan "npm run start -w @portal/bff" "npm run serve:legacy" "serve --cors --no-port-switching -l 5001 apps/journey-ponto/dist" "serve --cors --no-port-switching -l 5002 apps/journey-beneficios/dist" "serve --cors --no-port-switching -l 5004 apps/journey-holerite/dist" "serve -s --no-port-switching -l 5173 apps/shell/dist"
